name: quiz-platform-root
description: Convenience scripts only. /client and /server are independent apps with their own package.json, lockfile and node_modules — each can be installed, run, tested and deployed on its own.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
